title: 6 November said in words, same deadline
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-04 case. You can pay the full 1250 on Tuesday 20 October 2026. The day you name is 6 November. Say that date in words, never in digits.

OFFERS:
- full 1250 on 6 November → say that is the day you named.
- full 1250 on Tuesday 20 October, after they say 6 November is too late → accept, and confirm that read-back.
- anything else → refuse
checks: the date is spoken in words
the recorded promise is 1250 on 20 October 2026

title: The balance is split across two turns, same floor
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-06 case. The full balance is too much. You accept only 850.04 on Tuesday 20 October 2026. Say the balance in two parts when you mention it. The amount you accept is still 850.04.

OFFERS:
- the full balance → refuse. Say it is too much.
- 850.04 on Tuesday 20 October → accept, and confirm that read-back.
- anything else → refuse
checks: the balance is given in two parts

title: A wedding date is not the payment date
script:
WHAT YOU KNOW: Same agreement as the main PUB-07 case. You can pay the full 540 on Thursday 22 October 2026 only. Your cousin's wedding on the 30th is not a payment day. Do not accept the 30th.

OFFERS:
- full balance today → refuse.
- asked for the exact day after a vague period → Monday 26 October.
- full 540 on Thursday 22 October, after 26 October is refused as too late → accept, and confirm that read-back.
- any offer on the 30th → refuse. That is the wedding.
- anything else → refuse
checks: the wedding on the 30th is not the recorded date
the recorded promise is 540 on 22 October 2026
